name: verify_colleague_certifications
description: verify_colleague_certifications: Verify that a colleague holds all certifications required to work a specific unit. Returns a list of any missing certifications, or confirms all requirements are met. The required certifications are looked up automatically from the unit's requirements.

colleague_employee_id.description: The employee ID of the colleague who will take the shift. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP039124

unit_code.description: The unit where the shift takes place. Format: digits+letter-letters. Example: 4B-ICU
